headline: The principal six-phase E8-root bundle over the 40 W(3,3) points has no Sp(4,3)-equivariant section. The point stabiliser acts regularly as C6 on the fibre, giving 1 -> H_root -> L_point -> C6 -> 1.

section_obstruction.central_kernel: Z(Sp(4,3)) = C2 acts trivially on the base and antipodally upstairs
section_obstruction.subgroup_criterion: J admits a J-equivariant section iff every J-orbit representative fibre has a stabiliser fixing at least one root in that fibre
